title: Harborline Domain Credit on a Certificate Renewal Carried by a Hosting Prefund
content:
**Product:** Harborline Customer Accounts. Reads the covered domain named on the certificate subscription, among the customer's Domain Registrations.

**Rule.** The Harborline domain credit of the prefund's certificate charge follows its covered domain: an active Harborline registration on Harborline DNS takes off $6.00, an active Harborline registration on external nameservers takes off $3.00, and any other covered domain takes off no credit. The credit is a fixed sum taken off the prefund's certificate charge.

| Covered domain | Nameservers on the domain record | Credit taken off |
|---|---|---|
| active Harborline registration | Harborline DNS | $6.00 |
| active Harborline registration | external | $3.00 |
| registered elsewhere, or a Harborline registration that is not active | any | none |

A covered domain in its grace period or in redemption is not an active registration and takes off no credit.
